subject.title: feat: add exact-turn capability projection reports

question: Should OpenClaw formalize a combined exact-turn capability report as a stable core diagnostic surface over the existing effective-tools inventory and trajectory evidence?
rationale: The foundational facts already exist, but the proposed unified schema, capability taxonomy, correlation rules, and publication contract are a new cross-cutting product surface requiring maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow combined report
options.body: Correlate one selected run with existing inventory and trajectory facts, emitting conservative redacted JSON and Markdown only as an explicit export artifact.

options.title: Document the existing workflow
options.body: Explain how operators use the effective /tools inventory and trajectory bundle separately without creating another stable report schema.

options.title: Keep aggregation plugin-owned
options.body: Expose only demonstrably missing generic correlation metadata and let an external plugin own capability-family aggregation and presentation.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow combined report
recommendation.body: Correlate one selected run with existing inventory and trajectory facts, emitting conservative redacted JSON and Markdown only as an explicit export artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows the broadest work across inventory, Gateway runtime, trajectory export, storage, and docs, making this the best routing candidate for the cross-boundary product choice.
